editorial.blurb: Federales delivers consistently stellar tacos and tequila in a high-energy Fulton Market space where fresh, flavorful meals arrive the same way every time.
editorial.insiderTip: Catch their grilled blackened shrimp tacos when available as a special, and don't miss the buy-one-get-one-free days for chicken taquitos—pair them with the green tomatillo dipping sauce.
